title: How Much to Experiment? Admissible Sample Sizes in Test-and-Roll Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2605.02414v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies welfare-based sample-size choice in finite-population test-and-roll experiments. A decision-maker conducts a balanced randomized experiment on $m$ of $N$ units and assigns the remaining $N-m$ units to the arm with the higher sample mean. Regret combines the welfare cost of experimentation with the risk of an inferior rollout. Direct minimax regret is uninformative when treatment-effect magnitudes or noise scales are unrestricted, while minimax-regret choices under parameter bounds can depend materially on those bounds. We therefore derive a sharp characterization of admissible sample sizes, defined as those not dominated in regret by any other sample size under the same rollout rule. Under a Gaussian approximation and continuous relaxation, the admissible set for two treatments is exactly $(0,N/3]$, with $N/3$ strictly dominating every larger sample size. translated_title: 实验多少才合适？测试与推广实验中的可容许样本量
translated_abstract: 本文研究了有限总体测试与推广实验中基于福利的样本量选择问题。决策者在N个单位中的m个上进行平衡随机实验，并将剩余的N-m个单位分配给样本均值更高的处理组。遗憾值综合了实验带来的福利成本与推广次优方案的风险。当处理效应大小或噪声尺度不受限制时，直接的最小最大遗憾方法不具信息量，而在参数界限约束下的最小最大遗憾选择则可能实质性依赖于所设定的界限。因此，作者推导出了可容许样本量的精确刻画，其定义为在同一推广规则下不因遗憾而被任何其他样本量所支配的样本量。在高斯近似和连续松弛的条件下，两种处理情形下的可容许集合恰好为(0, N/3]，且N/3严格优于所有更大的样本量。这一刻画既不需要先验分布，也不需要外部（信息）……
tldr: 本文精确刻画了测试与推广实验中基于遗憾标准的可容许样本量集合，证明在两种处理的情形下可容许样本量恰好为(0, N/3]，且N/3严格优于所有更大的样本量，且该结果无需依赖先验分布。
en_tdlr: This paper sharply characterizes admissible sample sizes in test-and-roll experiments, showing that for two treatments the admissible set is exactly (0, N/3], with N/3 strictly dominating every larger sample size without requiring a prior.
